arxiv-2011-05672.title: On the Conditions of Aliasing Effects in Constellations with More than Four Spacecraft
arxiv-2011-05672.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by . The k-filtering/wave telescope method has been successfully applied to the four-spacecraft measurements from Cluster II and MMS, revealing the four-dimensional power spectral density PSD ​ ( ω , 𝐤 ) \textrm{PSD}(\omega,\mathbf{k}) . As the number of spacecraft within a constellation increases, the geometry becomes more complicated, and it is harder to find the first-Brillouin-like zone, since we cannot use known formulas to calculate the geometry of the zone.

arxiv-2106-11531.title: Graph Routing between Capsules
arxiv-2106-11531.creator: Yang Li, Wei Zhao, Erik Cambria, Suhang Wang, Steffen Eger
arxiv-2106-11531.description: Abstract Routing methods in capsule networks often learn a hierarchical relationship for capsules in successive layers, but the intra-relation between capsules in the same layer is less studied, while this intra-relation is a key factor for the semantic understanding in text data.

arxiv-2205-10666.title: MultiBiSage: A Web-Scale Recommendation System Using Multiple Bipartite Graphs at Pinterest DOI: 10.1145/1122445.1122456 Conference: ; ; Price: 15.00 ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/18/06
arxiv-2205-10666.creator: Saket Gurukar † , Nikil Pancha ‡ , Andrew Zhai ‡ , Eric Kim ‡ , Samson Hu ‡ , Srinivasan Parthasarathy † , Charles Rosenberg ‡ , Jure Leskovec ‡
arxiv-2205-10666.description: Abstract . Graph Convolutional Networks (GCN) can efficiently integrate graph structure and node features to learn high-quality node embeddings. These embeddings can then be used for several tasks such as recommendation and search. At Pinterest, we have developed and deployed PinSage, a data-efficient GCN that learns pin embeddings from the Pin-Board graph.

arxiv-2302-12859.title: THE PIONEER VENUS ORBITER CATALOG OF GAMMA-RAY BURSTS
arxiv-2302-12859.creator: E. E. Fenimore, A. Crider, J. J. M. in’T Zand, R. W. Klebesadel, J. G. Laros, M. Meier
arxiv-2302-12859.description: Abstract The Pioneer Venus Orbiter (PVO) Gamma-ray burst experiment detected 318 gamma-ray bursts over about 14 years between 1978 and 1992 with near 4 ​ π 4\pi coverage. This data set complements BATSE by determining the properties of the brightest GRBs.

arxiv-2305-03124.title: Games Under Network Uncertainty Thanks: This paper supercedes a previous paper with the title “Network Games under Incomplete Information on Graph Realizations”. We would like to thank Eric Bahel, Francis Bloch, Christophe Bravard, Krishna Dasaratha, Ben Golub, Matthew Jackson, Sumit Joshi, Matthew
arxiv-2305-03124.creator: Promit K. Chaudhuri, Sudipta Sarangi, Hector Tzavellas
arxiv-2305-03124.description: Abstract We consider an incomplete information network game in which agents’ information is restricted only to the identity of their immediate neighbors. Agents form beliefs about the adjacency pattern of others and play a linear-quadratic effort game to maximize interim payoffs. We establish the existence and uniqueness of Bayesian-Nash equilibria in pure strategies.

arxiv-2308-04348.title: An infinite family of internal congruences modulo powers of 2 2 for partitions into odd parts with designated summands
arxiv-2308-04348.creator: Shane Chern, James A. Sellers
arxiv-2308-04348.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Shane Chern, James A. Sellers. In 2002, Andrews, Lewis, and Lovejoy introduced the combinatorial objects which they called partitions with designated summands . These are built by taking unrestricted integer partitions and designating exactly one of each occurrence of a part.

arxiv-2310-00703.title: A Comparative Study of Training Objectives for Clarification Facet Generation Conference: Annual International ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and Development in Information Retrieval in the Asia Pacific Region; November 26–28, 2023; Beijing, China Annual International ACM SIGIR Conference on Resea
arxiv-2310-00703.creator: Shiyu Ni, Keping Bi, Jiafeng Guo, Xueqi Cheng
arxiv-2310-00703.description: Abstract . Due to the ambiguity and vagueness of a user query, it is essential to identify the query facets for the clarification of user intents. Existing work on query facet generation has achieved compelling performance by sequentially predicting the next facet given previously generated facets based on pre-trained language generation models such as BART.

arxiv-2406-13389.title: Unifying Mixed Gas Adsorption in Molecular Sieve Membranes and MOFs using Machine Learning Journal: Separation and Purification Technology | Accepted on June 16, 2024
arxiv-2406-13389.creator: Subhadeep Dasgupta, Amal R S, Prabal K. Maiti
arxiv-2406-13389.description: Abstract Recent machine learning models to accurately obtain gas adsorption isotherms focus on polymers or metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) separately. The difficulty in creating a unified model that can predict the adsorption trends in both types of adsorbents is challenging, owing to the diversity in their chemical structures.

arxiv-2410-18590.title: Speech perception: a model of word recognition
arxiv-2410-18590.creator: Jean-Marc Luck, Anita Mehta
arxiv-2410-18590.description: Abstract We present a model of speech perception which takes into account effects of correlations between sounds. Words in this model correspond to the attractors of a suitably chosen descent dynamics. The resulting lexicon is rich in short words, and much less so in longer ones, as befits a reasonable word length distribution.

arxiv-2505-01304.title: Epimorphic subgroups of simple algebraic groups
arxiv-2505-01304.creator: Donna M. Testerman, Adam R. Thomas
arxiv-2505-01304.description: Abstract . A morphism of linear algebraic groups ϕ : K → G \phi:K\rightarrow G is called an epimorphism if it admits right cancellation. A subgroup H ≤ G H\leq G is epimorphic if the inclusion map is an epimorphism.

arxiv-2507-03245.title: Real-time prediction of plasma instabilities with sparse-grid-accelerated optimized dynamic mode decomposition
arxiv-2507-03245.creator: Kevin Gill, Ionu t , -Gabriel Farca s ,, Silke Glas, Benjamin J. Faber
arxiv-2507-03245.description: Abstract Parametric data-driven reduced-order models (ROMs) that embed dependencies in a large number of input parameters are crucial for enabling many-query tasks in large-scale problems. These tasks, including design optimization, control, and uncertainty quantification, are essential for developing digital twins in real-world applications.

pmc-11437883.title: Aberrant positivity for BCOR immunohistochemistry in merkel cell carcinoma - a potential diagnostic pitfall
pmc-11437883.creator: Viola Katharina Vetter, Martina Haberecker, Florian Alexander Huber, Chantal Pauli
pmc-11437883.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackrgoundMerkel cell carcinoma (MCC) is a rare, aggressive primary cutaneous neuroendocrine carcinoma, frequently associated with clonal Merkel cell polyomavirus integration. MCC can pose significant diagnostic challenges due to its diverse clinical presentation and its broad histological differential diagnosis. Histologically, MCC presents as a small-round-blue cell neoplasm, where the differential diagnosis includes basal cell carcinoma, melanoma, hematologic malignancies, round cell sarcoma and metastatic small cell carcinoma of any site.

pmc-12429160.title: Local Forms of Vigna unguiculata—Response to Osmotic Stress at Vegetative Growth Stage
pmc-12429160.creator: Lyudmila Simova-Stoilova, Liliana Gigova, Valentin Velinov, Tsvetelina Stoilova
pmc-12429160.description: Cowpea (Vigna unguiculata L. Walp.) is a species with superior tolerance to drought stress compared to other legumes. It is a promising crop with increasing importance in the face of global climate changes. Local forms, well adapted to particular agro-climatic conditions, are useful germplasm resources.

pmc-12696407.title: Prevalence and characterization of carbapenem-resistant gram-negative bacteria from poultry in Tamil Nadu, India
pmc-12696407.creator: Seshan Sivasankar, Martin Peter Grobusch, Frieder Schaumburg, Sankarganesh Jeyaraj
pmc-12696407.description: Recent emergence of carbapenem-resistant bacteria in poultry has raised concerns on the potential transmission to humans.We aimed to investigate the molecular epidemiology, genotype and phenotype of the carbapenem-resistant gram-negative bacteria isolated from raw chicken meat samples from India and to evaluate resistance and virulence genes through whole genome sequencing (WGS).

pmc-13348190.creator: Gregor Fischer, Stefan Dudli, Eva Kilian, Friederike Schömig, Dave Oriordan, Jani Puhakka, Raluca Reitmeir, Mario Ropelato, Daniel Haschtmann, Frank Kleinstück, Tamás Fekete, Dezsö J Jeszenszky, François Porchet, Peter Vajkoczy, Oliver Bozinov, Fabio Galbusera, Markus Loibl

pmc-13372872.creator: Shan Meng, Jing Cai, Fenfang Qiu, Lihong Shu, Guangzheng Han, Zhenghui Xiong
pmc-13372872.description: Statement of problemSupplemental teeth are supernumerary replicas of normal teeth. They often involve the maxillary lateral incisors (MxLI), affecting both function and aesthetics of anterior dentition.PurposeTo investigate the prevalence of supplemental MxLI through panoramic radiographs, analysing distribution patterns and clinical attributes.MethodsWe retrieved panoramic radiographs of 146,538 patients treated at Suzhou Stomatological Hospital between January 2014 and December 2024.

pmc-13486496.title: Interfacial chirality-induced magnetic-field-free switching with high energy efficiency in all-vdW heterostructures
pmc-13486496.creator: Kai-Xuan Zhang, Suik Cheon, Seungbok Lee, Joonyoung Choi, Jihoon Keum, Hyuncheol Kim, Yeochan An, Woonghee Cho, Suhan Son, Jingyuan Cui, Pyeongjae Park, Younjung Jo, Jun Sung Kim, Hyun-Woo Lee, Je-Geun Park
pmc-13486496.description: Chirality, a central concept across many scientific disciplines, continues to inspire the discovery of novel physical phenomena. In condensed matter physics, structural chirality—defined by the absence of mirror plane symmetries—has primarily been explored in bulk materials. However, new chiral phenomena can emerge uniquely at the interface, distinct from their bulk counterparts, when a chiral material forms a heterostructure.
